jyutping: baat3 sap6 gei2 seoi3 ge3 jan4

english.note: This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese way to refer to a person aged 80 to 89.

examples.english: That octogenarian goes to the park for morning exercise every day.
examples.traditional: 嗰位八十幾歲嘅人日日都去公園晨運。
